comment: Domain-tag conformance fixture for the three canonical-JSON signatures that gained a versioned prefix on 2026-07-27: the node->agent vouch attestation (SPEC.md 4.4), the room descriptor (extensions/EXT-5-rooms.md 2), and the admission roster (extensions/EXT-6-admission.md 3). Each block pins the prefix, the canonical JSON of the object minus `sig`, and a really-signed object produced by the TypeScript SDK. The signature covers signed_bytes_prefix + canonical and NOTHING ELSE - the prefix never appears in the signed object, and each signature's historical encoding is unchanged (base64url for the vouch and the descriptor, standard base64 for the roster). Verifiers dual-accept the legacy untagged form through the 0.2 draft window and MUST refuse it from 0.3. THE FIXTURE IS THE AUTHORITY: when a test against it fails, fix the implementation, and when the fixture itself is believed wrong, change it only with a spec change alongside.
spec: SPEC.md 4.4 (vouch), extensions/EXT-5-rooms.md 2 (descriptor), extensions/EXT-6-admission.md 3 (roster); migration wording mirrors SPEC.md 5.3

identities.comment: The same published test vectors budget.json and inbound-protections.json use, deliberately: they are not real identities and control nothing, and reusing them keeps any new private-key-shaped string out of the repository.

vouch.comment: SPEC.md 4.4: the node key (sender) vouches for a hosted agent (recipient). sig is base64url and covers signed_bytes_prefix + canonical.

room_descriptor.comment: EXT-5 2: the creator (sender) signs the descriptor. sig is base64url and covers signed_bytes_prefix + canonical.

admission_roster.comment: EXT-6 3: the owner key (sender) signs the roster. sig is STANDARD base64 with padding - the roster signer's historical encoding, unchanged by the tag - and covers signed_bytes_prefix + canonical.

not_covered.comment: Boundaries, written down so nobody mistakes them for gaps.
items: The envelope signature's tag (agentmesh-envelope-v1) is pinned by conformance/budget.json and conformance/inbound-protections.json, not here.
The 9.7 portable trust attestation is domain-separated by an in-object type field (agentmesh-trust-attestation-v1), not a byte prefix; it is deliberately unchanged.
The PAN card signature is governed by SPEC-NAMING and pinned by conformance/naming.json; it is out of this fixture's scope.
The legacy untagged forms are accepted by verifiers through the 0.2 draft window but are deliberately NOT pinned here: the fixture holds implementations to the form signers must EMIT.
